command:
set -euo pipefail
BEFORE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
python - <<'PY'
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import time
print('LIVE_OVERLAP_START=' + datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), flush=True)
for i in range(1, 6):
    time.sleep(4)
    print(f'LIVE_OVERLAP_TICK={i} AT=' + datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), flush=True)
print('LIVE_OVERLAP_END=' + datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), flush=True)
PY
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BEFORE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
